artworks.title: The Madonna and Child with Saints Francis and Anthony Abbot and a Donor
artworks.medium: red chalk (wetted for counterproofing) on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of five people in monochromatic brown tones. Four figures are fully visible, with two standing at each end, one sitting in the center holding a baby, and one kneeling. The figures have simple features indicating age and gender, along with detailed clothing. The background features a tree, suggesting an outdoor setting. In the upper left corner, a handwritten annotation is visible.

artworks.title: Profile of a Man
artworks.medium: black chalk with stumping and touches of red chalk heightened with white on laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a person's head and upper body. The individual is facing to the left, displaying a side view of their face and torso. The person has a slightly rounded face with a defined nose and chin, and seems to be wearing a hat that covers much of their hair. They are dressed in a simple robe or tunic covering their shoulders. The background is plain and light beige, emphasizing the figure in the foreground. The image has a sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: The Fall of Phaethon
artworks.artist: Agnolo Bronzino or Giulio Clovio after Michelangelo
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with dynamic figures and horses in motion. The upper portion shows a figure falling or descending, possibly from a chariot drawn by rearing horses. Below are human-like figures, some gesturing dramatically. The drawing is detailed, focusing on anatomy and movement through lines and shading.

artworks.title: Saint Mary Magdalene Lifted by Angels
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of angelic figures surrounding a central figure. The drawing features angelic figures depicted in a classical style with flowing robes and feathered wings, gathered around a central, reclining figure. The scene depicts a moment of care or protection, with the figures intertwined and creating a sense of movement. The drawing is rendered with a subtle use of sepia tones, primarily browns and grays that provide a sense of depth and contour. The strokes are fluid and sketchy, with a dynamic and expressive quality that captures the emotional essence of the scene. The background is left largely unmarked, keeping the focus on the figures and their interactions.

artworks.title: Venus and Cupid Discovering the Body of Adonis
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image is a sepia-toned sketch showing three figures. The central figure is reclining on a large, flowing form, positioned semi-upright with a gentle tilt. This figure has indistinct facial features, long, wavy hair, and wears a loose, flowing garment. Below the central figure, a smaller figure with a similarly obscured face looks upwards, partially wrapped in the same flowing material. The third figure lies horizontally at the bottom of the composition, with a relaxed posture. The background is mostly blank.

artworks.title: The Portico of the Pantheon
artworks.medium: pen and dark brown ink with gray and gray-brown wash over red chalk, on three pieces of paper glued together vertically
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 21 x 30 cm (8 1/4 x 11 13/16 in.)
left section: 21.1 x 8.4 cm (8 5/16 x 3 5/16 in.)
center section: 21 x 18.6 cm (8 1/4 x 7 5/16 in.)
right section: 21 x 7.4 cm (8 1/4 x 2 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand architectural interior with tall columns. The drawing captures an interior space characterized by a multitude of large columns that reach up towards a series of intricately detailed arches and a vaulted ceiling. The drawing uses loose, expressive lines to depict the play of light and shadow, with a limited color palette dominated by browns and earthy tones. The architectural details imply a monumental scale and a sense of grandiosity.

artworks.title: The Bay of Naples with Mounts Vesuvius and Somma
artworks.medium: watercolor with pen and black ink over graphite on laid paper mounted to paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image depicts a coastal cityscape with distant mountains. The horizon is just above the center, dividing the city and bay from the sky. Detailed brushstrokes are visible, especially in the buildings and clouds. The color palette is soft, with pale blues and grays in the sky and earthy browns and beiges in the city and mountains. A sailboat is in the water, with the city extending to the right and mountains in the background, partly covered by clouds. The scene is serene and picturesque, showcasing the beauty of a coastal city under a clear sky.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on antique laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a figure in a crucifixion pose, with arms stretched horizontally and feet crossed. The figure's head is tilted to the side and slightly downward, with closed eyes and a serene expression. The figure has long, wavy hair hanging down past the shoulders, and is wearing a piece of fabric around the waist and hips. The background is plain, with a textured surface resembling aged paper. There are no visible details of jewelry or objects being held by the figure.

artworks.title: Female Figure Kneeling in Prayer [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on antique laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing shows the upper portion of a person in a kneeling position. The figure is turned to the right, with hands clasped in a prayer-like posture. The person's facial features are delicately sketched with closed eyes, a serene expression, and hair cascading down in loose, wavy locks past the shoulders. The clothing consists of a long flowing robe or gown that drapes prominently around the figure, with the fabric depicted in elaborate, thick folds. No visible jewelry or objects are held by the person. The background is a plain, lightly textured surface, typical of sketch paper.

artworks.title: Knight in Armor, Holding a Halberd
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink, point of the brush and black ink, and gray wash, heightened with white, on brown prepared paper (upper corners made up)

artworks.title: A Farmstead in a Wood
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and watercolor with white gouache on 4 joined pieces of parchment
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's eye view of a dense forest landscape with a small farm nestled among the greenery. Detailed trees are depicted in rows at the bottom of the image, with a clearing in the center where buildings with triangular roofs are surrounded by large trees. The rooftops are highlighted in red and earthy tones, contrasting with the predominant deep greens and browns. The brushstrokes are detailed, providing a textured appearance to the foliage, which is depicted with curling lines and stippled dots. The color palette is mainly subdued, with gentle greens and browns creating a calming visual impact.

artworks.title: Female Nude Praying
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: Drawn with brown ink on tan paper, a nude woman stands with her back to us, looking up and to our right with her hands together in prayer on this vertical sheet. Taking up most of the composition, she stands with her weight on her right foot and her left foot extended behind her and to the side. A scarf wraps around her hair and one end trails down her left shoulder. The edge of her right cheek and the tip of her nose are visible. Thin strokes outline the ample contours of her body and loose, parallel, curved strokes are used to create shadows on her arms, back, and legs. Tightly packed lines create darker shadows on her face.

artworks.title: Mary and John before the Man of Sorrows
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a religious or mythical scene. The composition features celestial and earthly elements, including cherubic figures floating among the clouds and a group of robed figures below them. The robed figures are arranged in a horizontal line, engaging with a partially draped male figure standing on a stone platform pointing towards them. The figures are detailed with flowing robes, varied expressions, and intricate linework suggesting movement. The background includes a subtle landscape, enhancing the sense of depth. The scene captures a moment of interaction, possibly invoking themes of divine intervention or spiritual revelation, with the presence of an angelic figure.

artworks.title: Cimon and Pero (Roman Charity)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with charcoal heightened with white on heavy laid paper; laid down (repair to Pero's ear)
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman interacting. The woman stands, holding the man's chin, while he leans toward her. The woman has curly hair and appears unclothed. The man wears a cloth around his waist and a headscarf, with chains on his feet. The background has plain walls with a column or beam behind the man, and Latin text in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Christian II of Denmark and Norway
artworks.artist: Circle of Lucas Cranach the Elder
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gouache on vellum
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the waist up, turned slightly to the side. The individual has a beard and light brown, curly hair, with rosy cheeks and fair skin. They are wearing a black hat and a pleated, ruffled collar. The clothing is illustrated in simple lines with detailed shading only around the neckline. The background is a greenish-blue color surrounded by an off-white field.

artworks.title: "Always Have the Bedclothes Folded up" [fol. 41 recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting an allegorical scene featuring various symbolic figures. The composition includes a central seated figure with a crown, holding a heart-themed object. Flanking this figure are two other figures, one standing on the right holding chains and a banner, and one on the left presenting a framed image. The artwork includes scrolls and tablets inscribed with Latin texts. The use of brown ink and fine lines is typical of the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Seated Satyr Leaning Backward [recto]
artworks.medium: black chalk with stumping, heightened with white on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure from the upper chest to the knees, reclining in a slightly twisted position. His left arm is extended upwards with an open hand, while his right arm supports his body on the ground. The man's head is tilted back, looking upwards with short, slightly messy hair. His facial features are partially visible, showing a focused expression. He is unclothed, revealing a muscular build. The background is a neutral, textured surface.

artworks.title: Man Reclining on the Ground and the Corner of a Bed [verso]
artworks.medium: counterproof in black and white chalks on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a male figure with his upper body partially visible. He is in a leaning or crouched position, supporting his upper body with his arm on a surface. The man's head is tilted downward, partially turned away from view, with short, wavy hair depicted in various strokes. The drawing does not display clothing, focusing on the natural form and muscles of the figure. The background features the faint outline of what appears to be part of a wooden boat or structure. The sketch is on a textured, pale sheet, giving it an aged appearance, and the use of lines and shading is evident in rendering the figure and the background elements.

artworks.title: Kneeling Man Bound to a Tree
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white chalk on gray-brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a muscular individual in a kneeling stance with one knee raised. The figure has arms raised above their head with rope details around the wrists. The head is slightly tilted back, and facial features are not detailed. The hair is tied back or in a bun. The person is depicted with a cloth draped around the waist, partially covering the lower body. The background includes a tree sketch, creating a natural outdoor setting. The artwork is done in red chalk on paper, emphasizing the musculature and dynamic posture of the figure against the less detailed background.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: red and black chalks, and pastel with stumping on gray-brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person's upper body from the shoulders up. The person is facing slightly to the right with their head turned towards the viewer. Their facial features include a prominent forehead, rounded cheeks, and light-colored eyes. The person's hair is light and wavy, styled back from their face. They are wearing a garment with a white ruffled collar and a brown vest layered over it. There are no visible jewelry or objects in their hands. The background is a soft, warm brown color without any distinct features.

artworks.title: The Avenue of Cypresses at Villa d'Este
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink with brown and gray wash red chalk counterproof on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: Cypress trees tower over either side of a walkway to nearly fill this vertical drawing created entirely in tones of sepia and faint brown. The walkway extends away from us and is lined to our left with a high wall and bushes or trees to the right. Several people sit or stand at the end of the path by the trunks and in the deep shade of the cypresses. Silhouettes there may also be statues. Beyond this group, a grand staircase leads to the entrance of a monumental, perhaps five-story building.

artworks.title: Mademoiselle Mary de Borderieux(?)
artworks.medium: Graphite and watercolor with white highlights
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner

artworks.title: The Throne Room at Fontainebleau
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on gray wove paper
artworks.description: The image illustrates an interior room with an ornate ceiling and drapery on the left side, including red and blue curtains. The color palette consists of pastel tones with hints of yellow and pale browns. The curtains cover the left side, with a portrait on the right. In the center, there is a doorway or large window showing another room. On the right, there is an additional doorway. A faint chandelier is present, hinting at the grandeur of the space.

artworks.title: A Dance in Spring
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts three children. Two children are standing to the left and center, interacting. They have curly hair with floral wreaths, delicate facial features, and wear flowing dresses. The third child is leaning over a ledge to the right, also with curly hair and subtle expression. The background is minimal with a horizon line and lightly sketched flowers. No prominent jewelry or objects are featured.
